568	def _validate_item(
569	    raw: object,
570	    job_id: object,
571	    snapshot: _Snapshot | None,
572	    references: bool = True,
573	) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bool]:
574	    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
575	        raise ValueError("batch item keys must be non-empty strings")
576	    if not isinstance(raw, dict) \
577	            or set(raw.keys()) not in (set(_ITEM_FIELDS),
578	                                       set(_ITEM_FIELDS_WITH_RECEIPTS)):
579	        raise ValueError("migration batch item has invalid fields")
580	    legacy = _ITEM_RECEIPTS_FIELD not in raw
581	    if raw["job_id"] != job_id:
582	        raise ValueError("migration batch item key must match its job id")
583	    plan_key = raw["plan_key"]
584	    if plan_key is not None and (not isinstance(plan_key, str)
585	                                 or not plan_key):
586	        raise ValueError("migration batch item plan_key must be null or a "
587	                         "non-empty string")
588	    phase = raw["phase"]
589	    if phase not in _ITEM_PHASES:
590	        raise ValueError("migration batch item phase is invalid")
591	    request_key = raw["request_key"]
592	    if not isinstance(request_key, str) or not request_key:
593	        raise ValueError("migration batch item request_key must be a "
594	                         "non-empty string")
595	    lease = raw["lease"]
596	    if lease is not None and (not _is_plain_int(lease) or lease < 1):
597	        raise ValueError("migration batch item lease must be null or a "
598	                         "positive integer")
599	    error = raw["error"]
600	    if error is not None and (not isinstance(error, str) or not error):
601	        raise ValueError("migration batch item error must be null or a "
602	                         "non-empty string")
603	    item_snapshot = raw["snapshot"]
604	    item_receipts = _validate_step_receipts(
605	        raw["receipts"]) if not legacy else []
606	
607	    if not references:
608	        # Intrinsic form only: a reader that has not opened the business
609	        # ledgers can still reject every shape, type, field-order and
610	        # enumeration error and every contradiction internal to the item
611	        # without following a single cross-reference. Cross-references
612	        # (accepted job, trade, plan, advice, settlement and the exact
613	        # receipt match) are the reference pass's job.
614	        if phase == "kept":
615	            if plan_key is not None or lease is not None \
616	                    or error is not None:
617	                raise ValueError("a kept item must not carry plan, lease or "
618	                                 "error data")
619	        elif phase == "failed":
620	            if error is None:
621	                raise ValueError("a failed item must carry the public "
622	                                 "error class name")
623	            if item_snapshot is not None:
624	                raise ValueError("a failed item must not carry a snapshot")
625	        else:
626	            if plan_key is None or error is not None:
627	                raise ValueError("an active migration item must name its "
628	                                 "plan key and carry no error")
629	            marker_actions = {
630	                "evaluating": ("evaluate",),
631	                "reserved": ("apply",),
632	                "claimed": ("start",),
633	                "active": ("record", "recover"),
634	                "settling": ("settle",),
635	            }
636	            if phase in ("evaluating", "reserved", "claimed", "settling") \
637	                    and not _is_marker(item_snapshot):
638	                # These four stages only ever persist a pending-action
639	                # marker; an active item may hold the plan snapshot and a
640	                # settled item its settlement record.
641	                raise ValueError(f"a {phase} item must carry a "
642	                                 "pending-action marker")
643	            if phase == "settled" and _is_marker(item_snapshot):
644	                # A settled item persists the settlement record, never a
645	                # pending action.
646	                raise ValueError("a settled item must snapshot its "
647	                                 "settlement record")
648	            if _is_marker(item_snapshot):
649	                marker = _validate_marker(item_snapshot)
650	                action = marker["action"]
651	                expected_actions = marker_actions[phase]
652	                if action not in expected_actions:
653	                    raise ValueError("migration batch item marker action "
654	                                     "does not match its phase")
655	                if action == "start" \
656	                        and lease != marker["request"]["lease_end"]:
657	                    raise ValueError("start marker lease must match the "
658	                                     "item lease")
659	                if action == "settle" \
660	                        and marker["request"]["plan_key"] != plan_key:
661	                    raise ValueError("settle marker must name the item's "
662	                                     "plan")
663	        return {
664	            "job_id": job_id,
665	            "plan_key": plan_key,
666	            "phase": phase,
667	            "request_key": request_key,
668	            "lease": lease,
669	            "error": error,
670	            "snapshot": copy.deepcopy(item_snapshot),
671	            "receipts": copy.deepcopy(item_receipts),
672	        }, legacy
673	
674	    assert snapshot is not None
675	    if job_id not in snapshot.accepted:
676	        raise ValueError("migration batch item must reference an accepted "
677	                         "job")
678	    if snapshot.cleared.get(job_id) is None:
679	        raise ValueError("migration batch item must reference a recorded "
680	                         "trade")
681	    binding_choices = [{"resource_id": snapshot.cleared[job_id]["resource_id"],
682	                        "version": snapshot.cleared[job_id]["version"]}]
683	    binding_choices.extend(record["after"] for record
684	                          in snapshot.completed.get(job_id, ()))

686	    def require_receipts_match(plan: dict[str, Any] | None) -> None:
687	        # The item's saved step receipts are exactly the plan's recorded
688	        # steps; an item that has not recorded a step carries none. A
689	        # baseline ledger item has no receipts field: its receipts are
690	        # derived from the referenced plan instead of enforced, so a
691	        # pending baseline batch still loads and normalizes on its next
692	        # commit while a completed one keeps replaying byte-for-byte.
693	        nonlocal item_receipts
694	        expected = plan["steps"] if plan is not None else []
695	        if legacy:
696	            item_receipts = copy.deepcopy(expected)
697	        elif item_receipts != expected:
698	            raise ValueError("migration batch item receipts must match the "
699	                             "plan's recorded step receipts")
700	
701	    if phase == "kept":
702	        if plan_key is not None or lease is not None or error is not None:
703	            raise ValueError("a kept item must not carry plan, lease or "
704	                             "error data")
705	        if item_snapshot not in binding_choices:
706	            raise ValueError("a kept item snapshot must be a current "
707	                             "binding")
708	        require_receipts_match(None)
709	    elif phase == "failed":
710	        if error is None:
711	            raise ValueError("a failed item must carry the public error "
712	                             "class name")
713	        if item_snapshot is not None:
714	            raise ValueError("a failed item must not carry a snapshot")
715	        failed_plan = (snapshot.plans.get(plan_key)
716	                       if plan_key is not None else None)
717	        require_receipts_match(failed_plan)
718	    else:
719	        if plan_key is None or error is not None:
720	            raise ValueError("an active migration item must name its "
721	                             "plan key and carry no error")
722	        if _is_marker(item_snapshot):
723	            marker = _validate_marker(item_snapshot)
724	            action = marker["action"]
725	            # The persisted action must match the stage that waits on
726	            # it; a mismatched marker is a broken reference just like a
727	            # missing plan or advice record.
728	            expected_actions = {
729	                "evaluating": ("evaluate",),
730	                "reserved": ("apply",),
731	                "claimed": ("start",),
732	                "active": ("record", "recover"),
733	                "settling": ("settle",),
734	            }[phase]
735	            if action not in expected_actions:
736	                raise ValueError("migration batch item marker action does "
737	                                 "not match its phase")
738	            marker_plan = snapshot.plans.get(plan_key)
739	            if action == "apply":
740	                advice = snapshot.advice_records.get(
741	                    marker["request"]["advice_key"])
742	                if advice is None or advice["job_id"] != job_id \
743	                        or advice["recommendation"] != "migrate":
744	                    raise ValueError("apply marker must reference a "
745	                                     "recorded migrate advice for the job")
746	                require_receipts_match(None)
747	            elif action == "start":
748	                if lease != marker["request"]["lease_end"]:
749	                    raise ValueError("start marker lease must match the "
750	                                     "item lease")
751	                require_receipts_match(None)
752	            elif action in ("record", "recover"):
753	                if marker_plan is None or marker_plan["job_id"] != job_id:
754	                    raise ValueError("record/recover marker must reference "
755	                                     "a recorded migration plan")
756	                if phase == "active" and action == "record":
757	                    # The record action is in flight. Normally the item's
758	                    # receipts are exactly the plan's steps. A crash
759	                    # between the downstream commit and the coordination
760	                    # snapshot update leaves the plan carrying the very
761	                    # step the marker persists while the item receipts
762	                    # lag by that one step -- the catch-up state re-entry
763	                    # completes -- in which case the plan steps must be
764	                    # the item receipts followed by exactly the marker's
765	                    # own step. Any other divergence is corruption.
766	                    req = marker["request"]
767	                    lagging = {"step": req["step"], "result": req["result"],
768	                               "receipt": req["receipt"], "at": req["at"]}
769	                    plan_steps = marker_plan["steps"]
770	                    if not (item_receipts == plan_steps
771	                            or (len(plan_steps) == len(item_receipts) + 1
772	                                and plan_steps[:len(item_receipts)]
773	                                == item_receipts
774	                                and plan_steps[-1] == lagging)):
775	                        raise ValueError(
776	                            "migration batch item receipts must match the "
777	                            "plan's recorded step receipts")
778	                else:
779	                    require_receipts_match(marker_plan)
780	            elif action == "settle":
781	                if marker["request"]["plan_key"] != plan_key:
782	                    raise ValueError("settle marker must name the item's "
783	                                     "plan")
784	                settled_already = any(
785	                    record["job_id"] == job_id
786	                    and record["plan_key"] == plan_key
787	                    for record in snapshot.settlements.values())
788	                if not settled_already and (
789	                        marker_plan is None
790	                        or marker_plan["job_id"] != job_id
791	                        or marker_plan["state"] not in _PLAN_TERMINAL):
792	                    raise ValueError("settle marker must reference a "
793	                                     "terminal migration plan")
794	                require_receipts_match(marker_plan)
795	        elif phase == "settled":
796	            settled = next((record for record in snapshot.settlements.values()
797	                            if record["job_id"] == job_id
798	                            and record["plan_key"] == plan_key), None)
799	            settled_plan = snapshot.plans.get(plan_key)
800	            if settled is None or item_snapshot != settled:
801	                raise ValueError("a settled item must snapshot its "
802	                                 "settlement record")
803	            require_receipts_match(settled_plan)
804	        else:
805	            if phase != "active":
806	                raise ValueError(f"a {phase} item must carry a pending-"
807	                                 "action marker")
808	            plan = snapshot.plans.get(plan_key)
809	            if plan is None or plan["job_id"] != job_id:
810	                raise ValueError("migration batch item must reference a "
811	                                 "recorded migration plan")
812	            if item_snapshot != plan:
813	                raise ValueError("migration batch item snapshot must be "
814	                                 "the current plan or a pending marker")
815	            if lease != plan["lease_end"]:
816	                raise ValueError("migration batch item lease must be the "
817	                                 "plan lease end")
818	            require_receipts_match(plan)
819	
820	    return {
821	        "job_id": job_id,
822	        "plan_key": plan_key,
823	        "phase": phase,
824	        "request_key": request_key,
825	        "lease": lease,
826	        "error": error,
827	        "snapshot": copy.deepcopy(item_snapshot),
828	        "receipts": copy.deepcopy(item_receipts),
829	    }, legacy

832	def _validate_progress_event(
833	    raw: object,
834	    position: int,
835	    batches: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
836	    ledger_inputs: dict[str, str],
837	) -> dict[str, Any]:
838	    # One incremental progress event, validated intrinsically: its
839	    # batch is a historical snapshot taken right after that commit, so
840	    # it must carry every field in canonical order and arity but it is
841	    # never re-followed into the business ledgers, whose plans and
842	    # bindings have legitimately advanced since.
843	    if not isinstance(raw, dict) \
844	            or set(raw.keys()) != set(_PROGRESS_FIELDS):
845	        raise ValueError("migration progress event has invalid fields")
846	    if not _is_plain_int(raw["position"]) or raw["position"] != position:
847	        raise ValueError("migration progress event positions must be "
848	                         "contiguous and zero-based")
849	    at = raw["at"]
850	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
851	        raise ValueError("migration progress event moment must be a "
852	                         "non-boolean non-negative integer")
853	    event_key = raw["key"]
854	    if not isinstance(event_key, str) or not event_key:
855	        raise ValueError("migration progress event key must be a "
856	                         "non-empty string")
857	    if event_key not in batches:
858	        raise ValueError("migration progress event must reference a "
859	                         "recorded batch")
860	    category = raw["category"]
861	    if category not in _PROGRESS_CATEGORIES:
862	        raise ValueError("migration progress event category is invalid")
863	    job_id = raw["job_id"]
864	    if job_id is not None and (not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id):
865	        raise ValueError("migration progress event job id must be null "
866	                         "or a non-empty string")
867	    if category in _PROGRESS_BATCH_SCOPED:
868	        if job_id is not None:
869	            raise ValueError("a batch-scoped progress event must not "
870	                             "name a job id")
871	    elif job_id is None:
872	        raise ValueError("an item progress event must name its job id")
873	    event_batch_raw = raw["batch"]
874	    if not isinstance(event_batch_raw, dict) \
875	            or set(event_batch_raw.keys()) != set(_BATCH_FIELDS):
876	        raise ValueError("progress event batch has invalid fields")
877	    if event_batch_raw["key"] != event_key:
878	        raise ValueError("progress event batch key does not match its "
879	                         "event key")
880	    inputs = _validate_inputs(event_batch_raw["inputs"])
881	    if inputs != ledger_inputs:
882	        raise ValueError("progress event batch must share the ledger's "
883	                         "business ledger set")
884	    owner = event_batch_raw["owner"]
885	    if not isinstance(owner, str) or not owner:
886	        raise ValueError("progress event batch owner must be a "
887	                         "non-empty string")
888	    until = event_batch_raw["until"]
889	    if not _is_plain_int(until) or until < 1:
890	        raise ValueError("progress event batch until must be a positive "
891	                         "integer")
892	    status = event_batch_raw["status"]
893	    if status not in _BATCH_STATUSES:
894	        raise ValueError("progress event batch status is invalid")
895	    if category == "completed":
896	        if status != "completed":
897	            raise ValueError("a completed progress event must snapshot "
898	                             "a completed batch")
899	    elif status != "pending":
900	        raise ValueError("a non-closing progress event must snapshot a "
901	                         "pending batch")
902	    items_raw = event_batch_raw["items"]
903	    if not isinstance(items_raw, dict):
904	        raise ValueError("progress event batch items must be an object")
905	    _check_sorted_keys(items_raw, "progress event items")
906	    event_items: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
907	    for member_key, item_raw in items_raw.items():
908	        # Historical snapshots always carry the current per-item
909	        # receipts arity; the stream is never written in baseline shape.
910	        item, item_legacy = _validate_item(
911	            item_raw, member_key, None, references=False)
912	        if item_legacy:
913	            raise ValueError("progress event items must carry the "
914	                             "receipts field")
915	        event_items[member_key] = item
916	    if job_id is not None and job_id not in event_items:
917	        raise ValueError("progress event job id must name one of its "
918	                         "batch's items")
919	    event_batch = {
920	        "key": event_key,
921	        "owner": owner,
922	        "until": until,
923	        "status": status,
924	        "inputs": inputs,
925	        "items": event_items,
926	    }
927	    if event_batch_raw != _canonical_batch(event_batch):
928	        raise ValueError("progress event batch is not in canonical form")
929	    return {"position": position, "at": at, "key": event_key,
930	            "job_id": job_id, "category": category,
931	            "batch": event_batch}

934	def _validate_progress(
935	    raw: object,
936	    batches: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
937	    ledger_inputs: dict[str, str],
938	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
939	    if not isinstance(raw, list):
940	        raise ValueError("migration progress events must be a list")
941	    progress: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
942	    # Per-batch sequence invariants. A batch that completed before the
943	    # stream was upgraded is legitimately known only by its seeded
944	    # closing event, so a creation event is not mandatory; but a
945	    # creation, when present, must be the batch's first event, and a
946	    # completed batch's last event must be the immutable closing
947	    # snapshot equal to the batch as it now stands.
948	    seen_keys: set[str] = set()
949	    last_by_key: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
950	    for position, event_raw in enumerate(raw):
951	        event = _validate_progress_event(
952	            event_raw, position, batches, ledger_inputs)
953	        event_key = event["key"]
954	        if event_key in seen_keys:
955	            if event["category"] == "created":
956	                raise ValueError("a batch creation may be recorded only "
957	                                 "once")
958	        elif event["category"] not in ("created", "completed",
959	                                        "taken_over"):
960	            raise ValueError("a batch's first progress event must be its "
961	                             "creation, a takeover or its seeded "
962	                             "completion")
963	        seen_keys.add(event_key)
964	        if last_by_key.get(event_key, {}).get("category") == "completed":
965	            raise ValueError("no progress event may follow a batch's "
966	                             "completion")
967	        last_by_key[event_key] = event
968	        progress.append(event)
969	    for event_key, event in last_by_key.items():
970	        batch = batches[event_key]
971	        if batch["status"] == "completed":
972	            if event["category"] != "completed":
973	                raise ValueError("a completed batch must end its progress "
974	                                 "stream with a completed event")
975	            if event["batch"] != _canonical_batch(batch):
976	                raise ValueError("the completed progress snapshot must "
977	                                 "equal the completed batch")
978	    return progress
